name: pulse-inertia-integration
description: Applies Inertia React v3 patterns to Laravel React components. Use when components touch page props, navigation, forms, Wayfinder route helpers, deferred data, useHttp, SSR boundaries, or Inertia-specific client behaviour.
purpose: Keep page props, navigation, forms, HTTP requests, and SSR integration aligned with Inertia v3 and local project conventions.
single_responsibility: Inertia v3 client integration for components: page props, navigation, forms, Wayfinder route helpers, deferred data, useHttp, and SSR/hydration boundaries.
triggers: Component reads or shapes Inertia page props
Internal navigation, Wayfinder route helpers, or links are added
Server-backed forms or standalone HTTP requests are involved
Deferred props, lazy data, or SSR/hydration boundaries are relevant
completion_criteria: Navigation and form APIs match Inertia intent (`<Link>`, `<Form<T>>`, `useForm`, `useFormContext<T>`, or `useHttp`)
Wayfinder helpers from `@/actions` or `@/routes` are used when route integration is needed
Page props are serializable, minimal, and stable
Deferred or lazy data has a visible empty, loading, or error fallback
Initial render stays stable for SSR/hydration
validation_criteria: Route integration is typed when practical
failure_handling: If the correct Inertia or Wayfinder API cannot be confirmed, stop and report the uncertainty instead of guessing at an integration that risks hydration mismatches or broken navigation.
Report any page-prop, form, or route decision left unresolved because controller, route, or prop context is unknown.
escalation_path: Route uncertain Inertia v3 or Wayfinder API behaviour through pulse-docs-research and `inertia-react-development`.
Escalate to the user when behaviour requires backend controller, route, or page-prop changes outside this skill's scope.
Hand generic state mechanics to pulse-state-effects and public prop shape to pulse-api-contract.
responsibilities: Use Boost docs and `inertia-react-development` for Inertia and Wayfinder APIs.
Keep page props serializable, minimal, and stable.
Avoid hydration mismatches at the server/client boundary.
non_responsibilities: Generic React state design not tied to Inertia.
